full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad featuring a female alto vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A clean electric guitar provides subtle arpeggiated textures in the background. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance is intimate with breathy delivery and light vibrato. Reverb is applied to both the vocals and piano to create a sense of space. The track maintains a minimalist, acoustic-focused production without percussion.
